insights.limitsBody: This platform uses your uploaded, unofficial study-guide-based question banks. Topics with fewer than three distinct first-seen observations are provisional, and repeated or memorized questions can overstate readiness. Older score-only history cannot reconstruct which concepts you missed on earlier retakes. Focus practice uses existing questions and is a revision tool, not new independent exam evidence.

laws.label: Fraud Laws · Interactive Exam Guide
laws.m1.b: SOX = public-company governance and internal controls. Regulation E = unauthorized electronic transfers and consumer protection.
laws.m2.b: GDPR = broad EU personal-data lifecycle and privacy. FCRA = US consumer credit-reporting data and related rights.
laws.m3.b: PSD2 = EU payment-services directive. UK Payment Services Regulations = UK implementation with SCA, unauthorized-payment refunds, and Confirmation of Payee.
laws.m4.b: Fraud Act = substantive fraud offences. ECCTA = organizational failure to prevent fraud benefiting the organization.
laws.m5.b: PSR = payment security and unauthorized-transaction protection. FSMA = legal basis for APP scam reimbursement regimes.
laws.m6.b: OLAF, CFPB, SEC, FTC, and the Payment Systems Regulator are bodies—not laws.
